snippet.title: Tales of Transformation in Pokémon GO—a new Season is here!
snippet.description:
How will you transform the ways you play during #PokemonGO’s Tales of Transformation? 🤩

The new Season runs from September 2 at 10:00 a.m. to December 2 at 10:00 a.m. local time.
